classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a live parliamentary session, created at the time of the events by the National Council.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary initiative debate recording from the Swiss National Council concerning the Road Traffic Act and residential quarters, held on 3 March 1983. The session included multiple speakers discussing legislative matters related to traffic and housing. It is an audio recording of the proceedings.
